label: Deployment: its pods, and who decides how many
api: the CPU and memory each pod reserves
code:
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 256Mi
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi

label: The workload this autoscaler resizes
code:
scaleTargetRef:
  apiVersion: apps/v1
  kind: Deployment
  name: api

label: The fewest and the most pods
Scale on CPU: 70% of what each pod reserves
code:
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70

label: Grow fast, shrink only after 5 calm minutes
code:
behavior:
  scaleUp:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0
    policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 100
        periodSeconds: 60
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300

label: Grow fast, shrink only after 5 calm minutes
code:
behavior:
  scaleUp:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0
    policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 100
        periodSeconds: 60
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0

label: Deployment: its pods, and who decides how many
Scale on CPU: 70% of what each pod reserves
code:
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: AverageValue
